Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1357
Claimant:
Rebecca Figueroa
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
10-21-23
Claim received for a collision at an intersection where the insured vehicle was turning left and was struck by an
oncoming vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the
attorney's office.
11-15-23
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the first notice of loss. They show damage to the front quarter of the
insured vehicle that is largely consistent with the impact described in the initial report.
12-9-23
Police report and statements from the scene confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of the
collision. No independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the parties and the photographs.
12-14-23
Checked the vehicle's prior claim history and inspection records. No earlier damage to this vehicle has been found in
any file.
12-23-23
Verified that the policy was in force on the date of loss and that no lapse or late endorsement is indicated. Nothing in
the file points to damage predating coverage.
1-5-24
The driver of the insured vehicle resides with the named policyholder and is listed as a household member, so
coverage applies under the policy's household provisions.
3-16-24
Medical records received show a neck strain as the primary diagnosis. The injury type and the force involved in the
crash appear to align well, and treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation.
5-12-24
Records also show treatment to the same area of the neck wihtin the last two years. That prior condition appears to
be adding to the current complaints, and the apportionment question has been noted for review.
5-18-24
The claimant has given the same account of events in every recorded conversation, and the details have not shifted
between contacts. File remains open pending the medical review and counsel's demand package.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
